summary.headline: Seasonal Judgments and Arab Era Days
summary.text: Seasonal and annual judgments use the ascendants of the Sun’s entries into Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn, with different procedures for movable, fixed, and bicorporeal signs; almanacs also record preceding conjunctions and oppositions. The text then introduces famous days of the Arab era, beginning with Muharram, Nowruz, and the numbered days, with differing interpretations involving Ramadan and early Islamic fasting days.
